# Harbour reopens after dredging

![Aerial view of the harbour](https://img.example.org/harbour.jpg)

The **city harbour** reopened on _Tuesday_ after eleven months of dredging work, officials said. Ships of up to
nine metres draught can now enter the inner basin, which had silted up over the past decade. See the
[port authority statement](https://port.example.org/statement) for details.

## What changes for shipping

- Larger cargo vessels may dock at berths 4 to 7
- Pilot fees fall by `12%` for night arrivals
1. Berth bookings open on Monday
2. The old ferry terminal stays closed

> The dredging was completed on budget, said the harbour master, who also thanked residents for their patience
> during the noisy works that began last winter and ran through the spring.

Operators expect the first large container ship to arrive within three weeks, which would mark a return to normal traffic levels for the regional economy.
